patterns: Dominant shape: national park -> state (single-fact or 'not correctly matched' pairs); Kaziranga, Bandipur, Kanha, Gir, Silent Valley, Similipal recur.
Park -> flagship species (rhino-Kaziranga, Hangul-Dachigam, Barasingha-Kanha, lion-Gir, musk deer-Kedarnath) is the second staple.
APPSC tilt: Sri Venkateswara NP (Chittoor), Papikonda (Godavari), AMVI 2023 pair Balpakram-Meghalaya trap; Yellowstone/USA and 'first NP' (Corbett) asked directly.
UNESCO natural WHS (Great Himalayan NP-HP, Keoladeo) appear; app adds many current-affairs counts (2026 PA numbers, Explorer tiger) and world parks beyond PYQ depth.
